summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Careers feature, admin password rotation and Arabic hero fix. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass: existing regression (auth login/me, invalid creds, news public + auth-gated CRUD, contact submit + list) plus new tests for admin new password (12a34b56cd21) succeeding, old password (TasnedAdmin2026!) rejected 401, careers POST 200 with PDF + persisted in careers_applications, careers 422 without cv, 400 for .txt (Only PDF/DOC/DOCX), 400 for >10MB file, and 401/200 auth-gated /api/careers-applications listing. Frontend: /careers full form renders, filled required fields + attached dummy PDF via data-testid career-cv, careers-submit fires and success toast 'Your application has been received. We will contact you if a suitable opportunity arises.' appears. Admin login with new password 12a34b56cd21 reaches /admin/news. Arabic language toggle sets html[dir]=rtl and hero <h1> ('اختبار موثوق لمياه الاتزان للسفن') renders fully at height 218.375px (line-height 97.2px, font-size 72px) — Arabic descenders no longer clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: Careers endpoint reads full upload into memory to compute size and to base64 for email attach — acceptable up to 10 MB but note memory usage under concurrency.
Startup seed_admin remains idempotent — re-hashes admin password from env if it doesn't verify, so password rotation via .env works with just a backend restart.
Cookies: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None with allow_credentials=True and explicit CORS origins — correct for cross-site auth.
Careers file validation checks both extension and size after reading; consider streaming/size-limit at request level for robustness, non-blocking.
test_credentials: admin@tasned.sa / 12a34b56cd21 (verified working; old password TasnedAdmin2026! correctly rejected)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed careers_applications entries and a contact request; all cleaned up post-test (careers: 2 removed, contacts: 2 removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers auth (incl. old-password rejection), news CRUD, contact, and full careers flow (success/missing-cv/invalid-type/too-large/auth-gated list). Reuse as-is.
